answer: Locks are written down in beacon, expire in crystal, and umber lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 130 aliases thus needs 31 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2442 identities would post 4964 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
